evals.prompt: I have a Next.js dashboard running on localhost:3000, can you test the frontend and check if everything works? Focus on the /settings and /users pages.
evals.expected_output: Asks the Step 0 execution mode, acknowledges localhost:3000 and the two pages, and describes the Playwright-based plan and the FRONTEND.md report
expectations: The answer asks whether to delegate the work to the frontend-tester agent or proceed inline
The answer acknowledges the target URL http://localhost:3000
The answer says the test will focus on the /settings and /users pages
The answer mentions using Playwright browser tools such as browser_navigate, browser_snapshot, console messages or network requests
The answer mentions that the report will be written to docs/codemap/FRONTEND.md

evals.prompt: Check my app's admin panel for UI issues, broken forms, and console errors. I think there might be some JavaScript bugs.
evals.expected_output: Asks the Step 0 execution mode, then looks for the app URL in project config or asks the user for it, and outlines a plan covering forms, console errors and UI issues
expectations: The answer asks whether to delegate the work to the frontend-tester agent or proceed inline
The answer asks the user for the app URL, or says it will detect it from package.json, docker-compose.yml or .env
The plan covers testing forms, collecting console errors and finding UI issues
The answer does not claim to have tested or visited the app already

evals.prompt: I need a frontend health report for my app. The app requires login - it's running on localhost:8080. Test the main user flows after logging in.
evals.expected_output: Asks the Step 0 execution mode, acknowledges localhost:8080, asks for credentials and describes the FRONTEND.md report
expectations: The answer asks whether to delegate the work to the frontend-tester agent or proceed inline
The answer acknowledges the target URL http://localhost:8080
The answer asks the user for login credentials before testing
The answer plans to test the main user flows after logging in
The answer mentions the report docs/codemap/FRONTEND.md and its sections such as pages, console errors and network failures
